subject: Pilot request: MRI de-identification pipeline — credits for nonprofit
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Hassan <amina.hassan@neurobridge.org>
To: soojin lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@neurobridge.org>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: MRI de-identification pipeline — credits for nonprofit

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NeuroBridge is a small nonprofit focused on sharing de-identified MRI datasets to accelerate dementia research. We have volunteer annotators and a modest compute budget — we'd like to run a 6-week pilot to evaluate Redwood's anonymization pipeline against our current open-source toolchain.

Request: a one-time grant of credits sufficient for ~50k tokens equivalent (~$3k-$5k in usage) and a 30-day trial extension on a private sandbox so our infra team can test the KV cache and quantized model without throttles. We can share a short SOW and IRB exemption note (attached).

Key constraints:
- Data must remain within their project VPC during the pilot; no sharing with third parties.
- We will not store PHI; the IRB exemption is attached but procurement will likely need a short attestation.

Attached: NeuroBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, IRB_exemption.pdf

Appreciate any guidance on process — happy to hop on a 30-min call with your solutions engineer.

Best,
Amina Hassan
Director of Data Operations
NeuroBridge Foundation
amina.hassan@neurobridge.org
+1 (415) 555-0184
From: soojin lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Amina Hassan <amina.hassan@neurobridge.org>
Cc: marissa cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request: MRI de-identification pipeline — credits for nonprofit

Hi Amina — thanks for the details and the attachments.

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Dr. Amina Hassan <amina.hassan@neurobridge.org> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick intro last week. NeuroBridge is a small nonprofit focused on sharing de-identified MRI datasets to accelerate dementia research...

We're happy to help — and congrats on the IRB exemption. Two quick items on our side before I loop in solutions for the sandbox:

1) Nonprofit verification: we have a standard intake for educational/nonprofit credit grants (simple org docs + W9/charity number). Procurement cc'd on your original email should suffice, but if you prefer we can accept a scanned charity letter.
2) Credit amount & duration: can you confirm the ballpark total compute hours (or a monthly spend cap) you expect? That helps us recommend a quantization profile and a credit amount that won't run out mid-pilot.

Marissa — can you advise on a credit bundle for a 6-week pilot for a nonprofit (50k tokens equiv)? Rishi — will need approval on the promotional credit and any exceptions to our private sandbox limits.

Amina — would a short sync Tuesday or Wednesday work? I'm in PST afternoons.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

From: soojin lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: marissa cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NeuroBridge nonprofit credit ask (SOW attached)

Team — forwarding NeuroBridge request (see attached SOW and IRB). Quick summary and recommended approach:

- Org: NeuroBridge Foundation (nonprofit; IRB exemption provided).
- Ask: one-time credits for a 6-week pilot; sandbox extension for private sandbox and KV-cache testing.
- Proposed grant: $4,000 in hosted credits + a 30-day private sandbox extension (no extra infra fees) so their infra team can test quantized models and KV cache behavior.
- Conditions: credit expires after pilot; usage alerts and a hard cap; no service-level changes (standard support only).

Why $4k: keeps them within the quantized model / batching profile we recommend and leaves headroom for retraces.

Questions for approval:
- Rishi: promo approval for $4k and extension to private sandbox limits?
- Marissa: confirm cost/rev implications and whether we can include a single 60-min onboarding session with a solutions engineer (no extra charge).

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (NeuroBridge)

Thanks,
So�jin
From: rishi malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: soojin lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: NeuroBridge nonprofit credit ask (SOW attached)

Thanks for the summary. Approved.

Two asks:
- Marissa, confirm that $4k can be booked as a promotional credit (rev-impact flagged) and that the sandbox extension is covered under the education outreach budget. If not, we can drop to $3k or attach a case study ask post-pilot.
- Soojin, include a one-time 60-min onboarding with solutions engineering and a simple credit letter (DocuSign) for procurement to sign — require signature for audit.

Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot request: MRI de-identification pipeline — credits for nonprofit

Hi Amina — great to confirm.

Good news: we've approved a $4,000 promotional credit for NeuroBridge and will extend your private sandbox access for 30 days to enable KV cache testing. A few next steps:

- I attached a short credit letter for signature and sent a DocuSign link to procurement. The link: https://docusign.com/brief/MB-NEURO-2027
- We'll provision the credits upon receipt of the signed credit letter and a confirmation of the testing project name (so we can associate usage with your account).
- Included: one 60-min onboarding session with our solutions engineer (Marissa will schedule).
- Limits: credits expire 60 days from provisioning; we will enable a hard usage cap to prevent overage.

If procurement needs alternate paperwork, let me know. Happy to do a brief call to walk through the sandbox access and key config (quantization recommendations: 4-bit dynamic; enable prefix caching).

Best,
